name: KeyboardTarget
description:
Links every input, textarea and contenteditable element inside it (including ones added
later) to the nearest OnScreenKeyboardProvider, through focus events that bubble up to
it. It renders a `display: contents` element, so it takes no part in layout; it must sit
where a `div` may. Outside a provider it does nothing.
signature: ({ layout, enterKind, disabled, children }: KeyboardTargetProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Leave the inputs inside unlinked: focusing them does not open the keyboard and `open()` ignores them.

props.name: enterKind
props.description: The Enter key's label for the inputs inside. Default: each input's `enterkeyhint`, else the provider's.

props.name: layout
props.description: The layout for the inputs inside. Default: what the input's `inputmode` or `type` asks for, else the provider's.
